page.overview:
Who is Gerudo Pirate?

In , Pirates are encountered as enemies inside the Pirates' Fortress, guarding Lulu's stolen Zora Eggs. They are found in rooms whose doors are marked by a golden scimitar panel. They drop down when Link enters, locking him inside and engaging him in combat. There are three of them each, one wearing green, one orange, and one pink.

Gerudo Pirates have an identical attack strategy to their Gerudo Thief counterparts from ; they are agile fighters who actively evade Link's attacks and strike back in-between. They are also able to perform spinning Jump Attacks as well that cannot be blocked. Like the Gerudo Thieves of , they will not attempt to kill Link but merely weaken him. If the young Hero of Time is hit by their Spinning Jump Attack at , he will be captured and thrown out of the Fortress. They can be fought using the Sword, Goron Link's punches, and Zora Link's fin punches or kicks. As Deku Link, they can only be damaged by his Bubble Blast.

After they are defeated, they angrily concede defeat before escaping by throwing a Deku Nut (similar to Impa and Sheik in ). Once defeated, the door to the chamber's aquarium opens, where one of the Zora Eggs are being held.
